tooling: pip install google-genai; curl multipart to /upload/v1beta/files
chaining: 20 GB/project, and Google Cloud projects are the multiplicative axis. But 48-hour retention means capacity, not storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap 2 GB. Retention-clamped hard at 48 hours — you cannot request longer. PDFs additionally capped at 50 MB / 1,000 pages for processing. Inline path is 100 MB total request.

'The Files API storage has an expiration time of 48 hrs and is restricted to 20GB total storage'
